title: ‘Document upload’ is coming soon: a quicker, easier way to send us your documents

content.text: We’re pleased to tell you that we're introducing a new ‘Document upload’ service in the Rural Payments service.

This new online service will give you a simpler, more secure way to send us documents and supporting evidence. Instead of using different methods to submit information, you'll be able to upload documents directly through the Rural Payments service whenever it suits you.
The service is designed to make things easier for farmers, land managers, agents and other Rural Payments customers, while helping us process information more quickly.
We know that customers currently use several different ways to send documents to us. This can sometimes mean information needs to be sorted and passed between teams before it reaches the right place.
You've told us that you want simpler, more direct and convenient ways to work with us, and we've listened.
When you upload documents using the Rural Payments service, they'll be sent directly to the team that needs them. This will help reduce delays and improve processing times.
The new service is part of our wider work to modernise our services and give customers more online options, making it easier to manage your Rural Payments business with us.
